name: KernelBench
description: An open-source framework and benchmark to evaluate language models' ability to write efficient and correct GPU kernels across 250 PyTorch ML workloads, using a novel metric measuring functional correctness and speedup.
reputation: An open-source benchmark that has attracted interest for measuring both correctness and GPU-kernel efficiency, but it is still relatively new.
notes: Measures both correctness and speedup of generated GPU kernels; remains challenging even for state-of-the-art models.
